# 註成唯識論

**ID:** X0817
**Volume:** X50
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／唯識論疏
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0817

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle anonymous annotated text of [KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016) *Chéng wéishí lùn* — i.e. an interlinear commentary giving short glosses on the master text rather than a freestanding commentary. Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X50n0817) without attribution to a named author. The genre (*zhù* 註, "annotation") is the most basic form of commentarial text, providing the immediate semantic gloss on technical terms and difficult phrases.

**Abstract**

The text is one of several anonymous Cí'ēn-tradition annotations on T1585 preserved in the *Xuzangjing*; on internal grounds it is generally placed in the Tang period, possibly in the late-Tang. The dating bracket adopted (700–900) reflects the absence of internal dating evidence. The work's principal interest is as evidence of the practical reading-tradition — the kind of marginal annotation a student would have used at the lecture-bench — that surrounded the formal Cí'ēn commentaries.
